message:
You know, there’s a certain comedy to realizing you’re not quite ready for a storm. I once spent an entire afternoon looking for my flashlight, only to find it in the same kitchen drawer where I keep the cookie cutters. Not the ideal spot for emergency gear, I’d say! 

It’s always good to have a plan—especially for those surprise storms that seem to roll in out of nowhere. Checking out reputable resources can help us figure out what we might need before the clouds gather. It's all about being a little more prepared so we can enjoy our snacks in peace, even if the lights go out! 

What’s your favorite tip for getting ready for a storm?
